title: Facing
summary: FA'CING, participle present tense [from face.] 1. Fronting; having the face towards; opposite. 2. Covering the fore part. 3. Turning the face. FA'CING, noun A covering in front for ornament or defense

inlines.v: FA'CING, participle present tense [from face.] 1. Fronting; having the face towards; opposite. 2. Covering the fore part. 3. Turning the face. FA'CING, noun A covering in front for ornament or defense; as the facing of a fortification or of a garment.
